revenue.label: Revenue
revenue.help: Sum of the billed amounts of all completed appointments in the month.

appointments.label: Appointments
appointments.help: Completed appointments. Cancelled and missed appointments are not counted.

revenuePerVisit.label: Revenue per visit
revenuePerVisit.help: Revenue divided by the number of completed appointments.

patientsSeen.label: Patients seen
patientsSeen.help: Patients with at least one completed appointment in the month. Each one counts once.

newPatients.label: New patients
newPatients.help: Patients whose very first completed appointment is in this month.

existingShare.label: Existing patients share
existingShare.help: Patients seen minus new patients, divided by all patients seen.

existingRevenueShare.label: Existing patients' share of revenue
existingRevenueShare.help: Share of revenue that comes from patients who had been with you before.

labRevenue.label: In-house lab revenue
labRevenue.help: Sum of the work done in your own lab. This part of revenue stays in the practice.

payerMix.label: Revenue by payer
payerMix.help: Revenue by the patients' insurance: statutory (GKV), private (PKV) or self-pay.

plansProposed.label: Planned treatment
plansProposed.help: Value of all treatment plans (cost estimates) created in this month.

plansAccepted.label: Booked from these
plansAccepted.help: Value of this month's plans that the patient accepted.

acceptance.label: Plan acceptance
acceptance.help: Accepted plan value divided by the plan value proposed in this month.

openPlans.label: Open plans
openPlans.help: Value of all plans that were neither accepted nor declined at the end of the month.

openUnder3.label: Open, under 3 months
openUnder3.help: Open plans created less than 3 months ago. Following up is most worthwhile here.

openOver3.label: Open, older than 3 months
openOver3.help: Open plans created more than 3 months ago. These are rarely booked any more.

instalments.label: Acceptance with instalments
instalments.help: Share of accepted plans with and without an instalment offer. Only plans where the offer is recorded are counted.

overdue.label: Overdue for check-up
overdue.help: Patients more than 30 days past their recall date who have not been in since.

nextBooked.label: Next appointment booked
nextBooked.help: Share of completed appointments after which the patient left with a new appointment.

missed.label: Missed appointments
missed.help: Cancelled appointments plus no-shows. Value = count times the average value of that type of appointment.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.help: Appointments cancelled by the patient or the practice.

noShow.label: No-shows
noShow.help: Appointments the patient missed without cancelling.

timeUsed.label: Treatment time used
timeUsed.help: Completed appointments divided by bookable slots. Holidays and closure days are already taken out.

neverBooked.label: Time never booked
neverBooked.help: Bookable slots minus completed, cancelled and missed appointments.

slots.label: Bookable slots
slots.help: Appointments that were possible given opening hours and treatment rooms.

onlineRequests.label: Online requests
onlineRequests.help: Requests via the website form, e-mail, the English and Russian site and Instagram. Phone calls are not included.

fast2h.label: Answered within 2 hours
fast2h.help: Share of online requests that got a first reply within 2 hours of opening time.

fastConv.label: Answered fast → patient
fastConv.help: Share of quickly answered requests that became a patient. Calculated over the last 6 months.

slowConv.label: Answered later → patient
slowConv.help: Share of requests answered later that became a patient. Calculated over the last 6 months.

missedPatients.label: Missed new patients
missedPatients.help: Estimate: requests answered late times the difference between fast and late replies.

channelConv.label: Request → patient
channelConv.help: New patients from a channel divided by the requests from that channel.

requests.label: Requests
requests.help: All requests from this channel, online and by phone.

igPosts.label: Posts
igPosts.help: Instagram posts published in the month.

igReach.label: Reach
igReach.help: How many times the month's posts were seen, added up over all posts.

igProfileVisits.label: Profile visits
igProfileVisits.help: How often someone opened your profile after a post.

igLinkClicks.label: Link clicks
igLinkClicks.help: Clicks on the link in your bio that leads to the website.

igMessages.label: Messages
igMessages.help: Instagram messages received. Not every one is an appointment request.

igRequests.label: Requests via Instagram
igRequests.help: Appointment requests by Instagram message or via the link in bio.

igNewPatients.label: New patients via Instagram
igNewPatients.help: New patients with Instagram recorded as their source.

adSpend.label: Ad spend
adSpend.help: Money spent on paid ads in the month.

costPerNew.label: Cost per new patient
costPerNew.help: Ad spend divided by the new patients from this channel.

returnPerEuro.label: Return per €1 within 6 months
returnPerEuro.help: Estimate: new patients times the usual revenue of such patients in their first 6 months, divided by ad spend.

npv6m.label: Value of a new patient (6 months)
npv6m.help: Average revenue of a new patient in the first 6 months, calculated from your history.

patientValueYear.label: Typical patient value per year
patientValueYear.help: Average yearly revenue per existing patient.

recallValue.label: Value of one recall visit
recallValue.help: Average billed amount of a cleaning visit over the last 12 months.

sessions.label: Sessions
sessions.help: Completed appointments of this type of treatment.

avgPerSession.label: Avg per session
avgPerSession.help: Revenue of this type of treatment divided by its sessions.

reviews.label: New reviews
reviews.help: New reviews on Google and ProvenExpert in the month, with the average rating.

visitsPerPatient.label: Visits per patient
visitsPerPatient.help: Completed appointments divided by patients seen.

value6mShort.label: Revenue per new patient (6 months)
value6mShort.help: Usual revenue of a new patient from this district in the first 6 months, calculated from history.

overview.byChannel: Requests and new patients by channel

revenue.payerLab: Payer and in-house lab per month

marketing.monthly: Requests and new patients per month
marketing.igTypes: Instagram by type of post (6 months to {{month}})

headline.down: Revenue in {{month}} was {{amount}} lower than the month before. Most of that comes from {{treatment}}.
headline.up: Revenue in {{month}} was {{amount}} higher than the month before. Most of that comes from {{treatment}}.
headline.flat: Revenue in {{month}} was almost exactly level with the month before.

bridge.title: Why did revenue change?
bridge.help: The change from last month is split into three parts. The three parts add up exactly to the difference.

count.label: Number of appointments
count.sub: {{current}} appointments instead of {{previous}}, valued at last month's revenue per visit

mix.label: Type of treatment
mix.sub: More or fewer high-value treatments than last month, at last month's prices

price.label: Prices within treatments
price.sub: The remainder: a higher or lower amount per session for the same treatment

bridge.sum: Together: {{change}}. That is exactly the difference between {{previous}} and {{current}}.
bridge.noPrev: There is no earlier month to compare the first month with.

factors.title: Revenue = patients × visits per patient × revenue per visit
factors.help: Each of the three factors has a share in the change. The three shares add up exactly to the difference.

money.title: Where is money being left on the table?
money.help: A cautious estimate of what could be recovered each month. Each card states its assumption.

plans.title: Open treatment plans
plans.text: {{full}} has been open for less than 3 months. We assume {{share}} of it is booked after a follow-up, spread over {{months}} months.

requests.title: Requests answered too late
requests.text: About {{count}} new patients were lost to late replies. A new patient brings about {{value}} in 6 months.

overdue.title: Patients overdue for a check-up
overdue.text: {{count}} patients are overdue. We assume {{share}} come back after a reminder, spread over {{months}} months.

missed.title: Missed appointments
missed.text: {{count}} appointments were missed, worth {{full}}. We assume {{share}} of that can be avoided.

money.total: Together about {{total}} a month. This is a cautious estimate.

top.title: What moved the numbers most?
top.note: These items overlap. They cannot be added up.

speed.weekend: {{share}} of the requests answered late arrived on Friday afternoon or at the weekend. They wait until Monday.
speed.form: The form is a request, not a booking. People who do not hear back soon often ask elsewhere.

ads.title: Does Google Ads pay off?
